symbols.name: change-of-basis matrix
symbols.meaning: An invertible $m\times m$ matrix over $\mathbb F_2$ that specifies the change of basis.
symbols.quote: A binary change of basis is specified by an invertible matrix in [Linear algebra basics](linear-algebra-basics.md): a matrix $M$ with an inverse $M^{-1}$ satisfying $M^{-1}M=I$.

symbols.name: bit column
symbols.meaning: The column of values of the selected bits, each an element of $\mathbb F_2$.
symbols.quote:
Let $m$ be the number of selected bits the change acts on, and let $
u=(
u_1,\dots,
u_m)$ be the column of their values, each $
u_i\in\mathbb F_2$.

symbols.name: address
symbols.meaning: A vector in $\mathbb F_2^m$, one address of the selected bits.
symbols.quote: For $M\in\mathrm{GL}(m,\mathbb F_2)$, $P_M$ is the address permutation that moves each value at an address $\kappa\in\mathbb F_2^m$ to $M\kappa$, so $(P_M f)(\kappa)=f(M^{-1}\kappa)$.

symbols.name: address permutation
symbols.meaning: The permutation of arrays of addresses that moves the value at each address $\kappa$ to $M\kappa$.
symbols.quote: For $M\in\mathrm{GL}(m,\mathbb F_2)$, $P_M$ is the address permutation that moves each value at an address $\kappa\in\mathbb F_2^m$ to $M\kappa$, so $(P_M f)(\kappa)=f(M^{-1}\kappa)$.

symbols.name: invertible matrices
symbols.meaning: The set of invertible $m\times m$ matrices over $\mathbb F_2$.
symbols.quote: Write $\mathrm{GL}(m,\mathbb F_2)$ for the set of invertible $m\times m$ matrices over $\mathbb F_2$.

relations.quote: A binary change of basis is specified by an invertible matrix in [Linear algebra basics](linear-algebra-basics.md): a matrix $M$ with an inverse $M^{-1}$ satisfying $M^{-1}M=I$.
A binary change of basis is an invertible linear change of coordinates on a block of [selected address bits](address-field.md), built over the [binary field](binary-field.md).
The change acts on an [address field](address-field.md), sending the bits $\nu$ to $M\nu$.
